units.en: For the Formable nations main page, see Formable nations.
List of formable nations in Europe
The following are nations that are formed primarily by decision in the ⟦0⟧ file or any other decision file labeled as formable nation decisions.
Mountainous Republic of the Northern Caucasus
United Kingdoms of Sweden and Hungary
The following are nations that are formed primarily by decision outside of the ⟦0⟧ file in .txt files not labeled as formable nations.
United Kingdoms of Hungary and Romania
The following nations are formed by other means.
United Kingdom of Portugal and Brazil

The ⟦0⟧ marks a unified country that controls the entirety of the Alps. ⟦1⟧ can form this nation by banning foreign Nazi propaganda and going down the path towards supporting the ⟦2⟧. With less and less democratic support, the confederation presses for Vorarlberg and expands its holdings via referendum in the neighbor regions. ⟦3⟧ eventually empowers the council and expands the current president's term period via the focus ⟦4⟧. At the same time though the country gains the opportunity to form the ⟦5⟧. The regarding decision will appear as soon as ⟦6⟧ controls an alpine state that is not a core.

This country represents the pluri-ethnic empire created from the Austrian Empire through a Compromise by the Austrian King and Emperor Francis Joseph I in 1867 with the Hungarians which then existed until its collapse in 1918. Up until its collapse, the Austro-Hungarian Empire was the second-largest empire in Europe, second only to the Russian Empire.

The ⟦0⟧ allows ⟦1⟧ to become this new country, swapping colors with ⟦2⟧, if following the monarchist branch. It requires the ⟦3⟧ to own all the states originally owned by ⟦4⟧. The ⟦5⟧ gets a decision to core the remaining Austro-Hungarian territories once all of them are conquered. The flag will change to the civil ensign of ⟦6⟧.

Should Germany depose the NSDAP government and restore the Kaiserreich, it is possible to take the focus ⟦0⟧ which will push the three main constituent countries to push towards the restoration. Once the ⟦1⟧ popularity in ⟦2⟧, the ⟦3⟧, and ⟦4⟧ gets high enough, the three countries will unite through an event similar to the above decision and reform Austria-Hungary. The Austria-Hungary created from this focus is otherwise treated as ⟦5⟧ rather than the ⟦6⟧. A player-controlled ⟦7⟧, the ⟦8⟧, or ⟦9⟧ is able to take the decision to form Austria-Hungary once Germany completes the focus and can be formed once the non-aligned popularity in all 3 countries gets above 40%, and will keep the original country's focuses and national spirits.
In 1.10, the focus ⟦0⟧ will give ⟦1⟧, the ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧. However, unlike ⟦5⟧, this focus will not give ⟦6⟧, the ⟦7⟧, nor ⟦8⟧ the above decision nor will they be able to become Austria-Hungary.

Baltic-Belarus is a collective term used to refer to three very closely related formable nations, namely; ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧. These formable nations can be formed by each of the three Baltic States ( ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧) and only one of them can be formed at any given time. The historical background for these nations is that they are each a reconstitution of the short-lived Socialist Soviet Republic of Lithuania and Belorussia, a Soviet puppet state that existed for approxmately five months during the Lithuanian-Soviet War and Polish-Soviet War of 1919-1920.

In order to form this nation, each of the Baltic States must progress down the communist branch of their national focus tree to overthrow the government through a civil war, which then opens up the option to convert the rest of the Baltic States to communism through a propaganda war (which allows one to form the ⟦0⟧) as well as acquiring Belarus for even more territory.

If the Baltic state opted to align themselves with the ⟦0⟧, the Soviets will cede their half of Belarus to the Baltic state, with the rest being acquired through either war or through the Molotov-Ribbentrop-pact and the partition of ⟦1⟧.

If the Baltic state opted to stay independent and enter opposition, then Belarus must be acquired through adversarial means. The Baltic state must propagandise support for unification in Belarus similar to the Spanish Civil War garrison control system. This starts a countdown timer and when that time runs out, Belarus will be released and a civil war will ignite in it; the victor will be annexed into either the victorious Baltic nation or the USSR. The rest of Belarus must be conquered from Poland by force.

The ⟦0⟧ represents the proposed federation of the Baltic states known as the United Baltic Duchy that was proposed in 1918 in the aftermath of the collapse of the Russian Empire. Ultimately, it never actually came into being but the Baltic states would continue to pursue a close relationship afterwards, something which is true even today.

The ⟦0⟧ is a formable nation that consists of mainland ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ and the three Baltic states ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧ and ⟦6⟧. It can be formed by ⟦7⟧. The easiest way to do so is by unifying the Right. Now you can either decide to follow the monarchist or the fascist path and in the end gain Conquer (Focus) war goals against ⟦8⟧ and the Baltic nations via the focus ⟦9⟧. If chosen, the ⟦10⟧, and the ⟦11⟧ cannot be formed.

The Byzantine Empire represents the eastern half of the Roman Empire following the division of the Empire into East and West in 395 AD. It is a formable nation. Following the collapse of the Western Roman Empire in 476, the Eastern Roman Empire (also known as Byzantium) would continue to exist for nearly another thousand years until its own demise in 1453. In contrast to the predominantly Latin culture of the Western Roman Empire, the Byzantine Empire was predominantly Greek in culture, despite being referred to as the Eastern Roman Empire.
The following decision is only available without the ⟦0⟧ DLC.
The cores of the Byzantine Empire can be expanded with the following decisions (It's not necessary to first form the Byzantine Empire in order to make use of these decisions):
With the Battle for the ⟦0⟧ DLC
The following decision is only available with the ⟦0⟧ DLC and when the Focus ⟦1⟧ is completed.
Once the decision is selected, ⟦0⟧ will be renamed as the ⟦1⟧ and change color to a purple color. The Byzantine capital will be moved to Istanbul, which is renamed back to Constantinople.
In addition, the following decisions become available after completing the Focus ⟦0⟧.

The ⟦0⟧ is formed by ⟦1⟧ when the focus ⟦2⟧ is completed. Furthermore, this unlocks decisions to core Central Europe and demand both ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ to join your federation, doing so they will become your puppets.
Estonia-Finland and the Empire of Finno-Ugria

Tracing its origins back to an age long-gone, to the time when the Finno-Ugric peoples inhabited most of Russia and Ukraine before the arrival of the Slavic peoples during the Migration Period of 300-800 AD pushed them out of their homeland and to the brink of extinction. Today, only two Finnic nations remain, ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧, but these nations can still pick up the mantle of the Finno-Ugric peoples and lead them to an ultimate final victory against the Slavs by conquering Russia and Ukraine and forming the ⟦2⟧ and securing their place in history as one of the great underdog victors and putting the Slavs into their one and only proper place; on their knees before the Finno-Ugria.

The ⟦0⟧ can be formed by ⟦1⟧ as part of the fascist branch of their national focus tree. This path has the fascist Vapsid movement gather popular support in Estonia and ultimately marching on the capital city of Tallinn and overthrowing the government in a civil war takeover. After this, the Vapsid movement can pull on its close connections to the similarly fascist IKL party in ⟦2⟧ and can offer direct support to said party to allow them to expand popular support across Finland, culminating in a march on Helsinki and a fascist takeover. From here, Estonia stands at a crossroads as to where her identity and destiny lies;

She can opt to lean into her Scandinavian side and seek to unite the Nordic countries of ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ under one flag by military force through the rest of the national focuses in that branch. If Estonia then completes the national focus ⟦3⟧, she will gain access to the decision to form the ⟦4⟧.

Alternatively, Estonia can decide to lean into her Finno-Ugric side and strengthen ties with ⟦0⟧, uniting both nations into the union of ⟦1⟧, mirroring the ambition of Estonian president Konstantin Päts. Once the nations are united, they may begin to mobilise their resources and prepare themselves for war with the ⟦2⟧ and launch a great war of conquest to annex Russia and Ukraine as well as the northern parts of ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ to form the Empire of Finno-Ugria. For best results, one can also opt to puppet the Soviet Union and release every releasable nation from them as puppets as well, thus destroying Russia as unified polity and having Finno-Ugria replace the Russians as the great eastern menace to the rest of Europe.

The decisions to form the ⟦0⟧ requires the player to follow the ⟦1⟧ path, have ⟦2⟧ as leader and complete the focus ⟦3⟧, changing the country name to ⟦4⟧. The first decision makes King Gustaf V into Gustavus Adolphus II with "the Great" trait and requires all Nordic starting core states, the starting core states of ⟦5⟧ and ⟦6⟧, the ⟦7⟧ states of ⟦8⟧ ⟦9⟧, ⟦10⟧ ⟦11⟧ and the ⟦12⟧ states of ⟦13⟧ ⟦14⟧, ⟦15⟧ ⟦16⟧. It gives compliance bonuses to the ⟦17⟧ and ⟦18⟧ states as well.

The second decision requires the additional requirements of the states of ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧, and ⟦6⟧ ⟦7⟧ from the ⟦8⟧, ⟦9⟧ and ⟦10⟧. This creates the ⟦11⟧, makes Gustavus Adolphus II "the Eternal" and cores the required states from the ⟦12⟧, ⟦13⟧, ⟦14⟧, ⟦15⟧ and ⟦16⟧.
The Nordic Peoples Free Democratic Empire

The ⟦0⟧ is a formable nation that initially represents a union between the original 6 countries that started the European Coal and Steel Community in 1952, the predecessor to the modern day European Union.

Historically speaking, ⟦0⟧ is the "legitimate founder" as after World War II with its homeland in ruins, its economy in shambles, its population depleted and its colonial empire breaking apart, France became desperate to avoid spiraling into a complete socio-economic meltdown and in 1956 the French government presented a proposal to form a Franco-British Union with the United Kingdom or simply joining the Commonwealth for aid. Both proposals fell through, and France instead turned to the defeated Axis Powers (Germany and Italy) of all nations and formed the European Coal and Steel Community alongside the Low countries to sustain itself, later reorganizing into the European Union.
Union of European Soviet Socialist Republics
Since patch 1.15, the European Federation has a set of decisions allowing it to core nearly the whole of Europe.

The ⟦0⟧ is a union that ⟦1⟧ and The ⟦2⟧ can form if France is capitulated by the Germans while allied to the UK, if both countries agree to the union, the United Kingdom will annex France and gain cores of all French cores. All French military units and leaders will be transferred to the UK. While the UK can get the decision regardless of ideology, France can only propose the union if it is Democratic.

Once forming the union it will only remain whilst Britain is at war. Whenever Britain becomes at peace there will be an event to release France, or keep them. Whichever option is chosen the UK will lose its French cores.
